digest.component_or_area: code-review criterion runtime and project overlay integration
propositions: Activated project-specific code-review criteria currently merge overlay successfully but never execute, causing silent failure indistinguishable from no findings
Code-review runtime must execute project criteria exactly once per review using a stateless fan-in discriminator (round_a) without adding workflow DSL fields or hard-coded project criterion ids
Project prompt and eval assets must resolve from the reviewed repository snapshot; missing or malformed assets must raise a fatal LLMError before model execution
Logical project criterion ids must map to sanitized physical prompt ids (code-review-project-*) at dispatch time; Pass 3 must consume only logical routing keys regardless of model output
Repository-effective routing for threshold, blocking posture, and nit-suppression must be computed once in Pass 3 deterministically without adding LLM steps or YAML input
CLI calibration and eval must accept ambiguous criterion ids (active in both plan-review and code-review gates) and reject them with explicit error rather than silent selection
